二瓶有加のturning pointは、「素が出た」より「素がworkとして読まれた」ことにある

Why does Yuka Nihei keep returning to NOBROCK TV? If we look only at her 2023 breakthrough, it seems like a simple story: her unguarded laughter went viral. But before that were years of idol work, stage acting, and self-produced YouTube; after that came observational performance in the 飲み会ノリ series and singing again with DRAW♡ME. This essay reads her turning point not as the discovery of a fixed true self, but as a process in which a media environment made existing abilities legible as work.
